observation.description: HOW TO PREPARE1. BLUEBERRY MILK TEADissolve completely 1/4 cup (50g) of Blueberry Powdered Drinks and 1/8 cup of Top Creamer in 120mL of hot brewed tea in a cocktail shaker. Add ice and shake well. Serve. 2. BLUEBERRY SHAKE/FRAPPEPour 1/4 cup (50g) of Blueberry Powdered Drinks and 1/8 cup of Top Creamery's Frappe Base with 50 grams of water on a blender.
